🔥 openpose | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: Real-time human pose estimation for multiple individuals in images and videos, enabling applications in human behavior understanding, motion analysis, and interactive systems.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time multi-person pose estimation • Detection of body, face, hand, and foot keypoints • Estimation of 135 keypoints per person • 2D and 3D pose reconstruction • Unity plugin available
📖 Summary: OpenPose is a real-time C++ library for multi-person keypoint detection, capable of estimating the pose of bodies, faces, hands, and feet from single images. It provides a comprehensive solution for human pose estimation and understanding in various applications.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 ux-ui-agent-skills | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To empower AI agents with the knowledge and tools to act as senior UX/UI design architects, enabling them to generate high-quality, accessible, and framework-agnostic UI components and design system assets.
✨ Key Features: • Design Token Generation (DTCG format) • Component Design (Atomic Design) • Code Generation (any framework) • Design-System Interoperability • Runnable Skills (17+)
📖 Summary: This repository transforms AI models like Claude into expert UX/UI design architects. It provides a comprehensive kit of instructions, design tokens, and runnable skills to generate consistent, accessible, and production-ready UI components for any framework and design system.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 optimizerDuck | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: Optimizing Windows operating systems for better performance and privacy.
✨ Key Features: • Performance optimization • Privacy enhancement • Simplicity of use • Debloating Windows • Open-source
📖 Summary: optimizerDuck is a free, open-source Windows optimization tool designed to enhance system performance, bolster privacy, and simplify user experience. It offers a range of tweaks and debloating options for Windows 10 and above.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 nerd-fonts | CSS
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enhance the visual appearance of code editors and terminals by adding a comprehensive set of icons and glyphs to programming fonts, improving readability and aesthetics.
✨ Key Features: • Patches popular programming fonts with thousands of extra glyphs from icon sets like Font Awesome, Material Design Icons, Octicons, and more.
📖 Summary: Nerd Fonts is a project that enhances programming fonts by patching them with a vast collection of glyphs and icons from popular icon sets. It provides an easy way to install these enhanced fonts or to patch your own fonts, making your terminal and code editor visually richer.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ mobile-mcp | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling AI agents and LLMs to automate native iOS and Android mobile applications through a unified, platform-independent interface.
✨ Key Features: • Platform-agnostic mobile automation API • Supports iOS and Android (simulators, emulators, real devices) • Accessibility-first interaction model • Fallback to screenshot-based interaction
📖 Summary: Mobile MCP is a TypeScript-based server that acts as a platform-agnostic interface for automating iOS and Android mobile applications. It allows AI agents and LLMs to interact with native apps on emulators, simulators, and real devices using accessibility data or screenshot-based interactions.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
